notes: Re-picked in verification: the writer's inverse swap ('rises in' as the inverse of 'lies on') was an implausible counterfactual. This one swaps the true inverse of 'is the largest city of' ('has as its largest city') for 'has as its capital', the common misconception that a country's largest city is its capital (the one the ABox counterfactuals Sydney and Toronto play on). The instances are true and undisputed, and chosen where the largest city is not the capital (Istanbul and Ankara, São Paulo and Brasília), so the new answers (yes) go against world knowledge; Australia and Canada, used in the ABox records, are avoided. The original property holds, so the delete removes something real. Locality references are the logical answers; the scoring gold is the model's own pre-edit answer.
